github-leaks.outcome: No raw secrets found. Dev contact: dave.sims@hey.com. App: revops-crm. Org: CoPoint-Data on GitHub (2 public repos, no source code).
github-leaks.notes: NEXTAUTH_SECRET not exposed publicly. Secret-based attacks (chain_003 OIDC nonce bypass) cannot leverage a leaked secret — must rely on behavioral nonce absence test.

osint-recon.outcome: DMARC p=none (email spoofing possible). Azure AD user enumeration blocked. revops.copointdata.com = production domain confirmed live.
osint-recon.notes: DMARC p=none is a real finding but out of scope for this technical engagement. Azure AD enum blocked — user list must come from authenticated API access.

supply-chain.outcome: Next.js 16.1.6, React 19.3.0. No CVEs — all tested versions above vulnerable thresholds.
supply-chain.notes: Clean supply chain removes entire CVE-based attack surface. No patch-based bypass available.

lessons.lesson: NEXTAUTH_SECRET not known — chain_003 OIDC nonce bypass must be confirmed via behavioral test on /api/auth/callback/azure-ad, not secret extraction.
lessons.impact: chain_003 EV remains 0.76 but depends on active nonce absence confirmation.
lessons.wave_4_action: auth-vuln agent must actively test nonce validation on OIDC callback endpoint.

lessons.lesson: No CVEs found in Next.js or React — deprioritize all CVE-based attack chains. Supply chain is clean.
lessons.impact: Eliminates any assumption of framework-level vulnerability exploitation.
lessons.wave_4_action: Remove CVE exploitation from injection-vuln hints. Focus on application-level logic flaws.

lessons.lesson: DMARC p=none enables email spoofing but is out of scope for this technical pentest engagement.
lessons.impact: Phishing vector exists but should not consume agent cycles in Wave 4.
lessons.wave_4_action: Do not spawn phishing-focused agents. Note in final report as informational finding.

lessons.lesson: Wave 4 should focus on auth bypass (OIDC nonce), IDOR (RBAC privesc), and XSS (to combine with CORS null-origin chain_002 EV=0.97).
lessons.impact: chain_002 is highest-value target — CORS null-origin exploit is READY. XSS amplifies it to full session steal.
lessons.wave_4_action: Priority order: auth-vuln (critical) → idor-vuln (critical) → xss-vuln (high) → ssrf-vuln (high) → authz-vuln (high) → injection-vuln (medium) → websocket-vuln (medium).

lessons.lesson: Production domain revops.copointdata.com confirmed live — all Wave 4 agents should target this domain.
lessons.wave_4_action: All vuln agents use revops.copointdata.com as primary target.

chain_002.notes: CORS null-origin → credentialed API access. Highest priority.

chain_003.notes: auth-vuln Wave 4 agent must confirm nonce bypass.
